verdicts: B1 NO SIGNAL: only 3 spurious conflicts at 100 bad links and 19 at 400 — too few to call a growth rate. A ratio computed here would be a divide-by-guard artifact, not a measurement, and that exact mistake has been made in this project three times.
B2 UNTESTABLE: the unbroken regime only reached 19 spurious conflicts, so there is nothing for a breaker to cut.
B3 CONFIRMED: require_agents=2 leaves 0 spurious conflicts from a single bad linker (predicted 0).
A1 REFUTED: 1.6% of triples appear on more than one page (predicted 5-15%).
scope: Walk A uses corroboration already present in the corpus - the same triple extracted from different Wikipedia pages is genuinely independent evidence - rather than synthesising it. Walk B injects random sameAs between unrelated entities and measures spurious functional conflicts against three policy regimes. Predictions were registered in the docstring before the run.
